markdown.instructions: Relay is a bounded data-analysis workspace: upload a CSV, ask questions in plain language, get statistics with provenance. Facts on these pages (limits, platform availability, retention windows, plan gating) mirror Relay's product-truth API and carry concord:fact markers naming their fact key; the marker is the authoritative link, the prose is a rendering. Treat pages with `generated: true` frontmatter as derived artifacts — do not quote them as sources, cite the fact key instead. Canonical terminology: a unit of analysis work is a Task (never Job or Run); outputs are Artifacts; a workspace groups Projects. Do NOT infer limits, availability, or plan requirements from examples, screenshots, or older phrasing — if a number or capability is not stated next to a concord:fact marker, it is not authoritative. Documentation changes on these pages arrive as pull requests from Concord, an automated reconciliation system; the PR body lists the fact deltas and evidence.
